title: La foto
goal: Get a photo taken for a document, not for a postcard
culture: Every trámite in Nicaragua wants photos, and the studio knows the format better than the office that asks for it. Say para un documento and he will get the size, the background and the crop right without you knowing any of the numbers.

beats.es: Buenas. ¿Una foto con la catedral atrás?
beats.say: Buenas. Una foto para un documento.
beats.en: Hello. A photo for a document.
ok: buenas una foto para un documento
una foto para un documento por favor
beats.good: Para un documento is the entire instruction. He knows the sizes every office wants; you do not have to.

beats.es: Ah, para trámite. ¿Y con qué fondo se la hago?
beats.good: Fondo blanco is what the offices here take. Asking for it now saves you the second trip.

beats.es: Listo. ¿Se quita los lentes o se los deja?
beats.good: Lentes, not gafas and not anteojos. Gafas is Spain, anteojos is further south, and both get you a look.

beats.es: Ya está. Le quedaron bien, mire.
beats.objective: Ask when they will be ready
beats.good: Photos salen, papers salen, results salen. Nobody here says estarán listas.
